recordings.note: No clip exists yet for any Word Garden sound, word or line. The game is playable without them (text and visuals), but a beginning reader needs every one. Phonemes must be pure and unvoiced where English is (no 'suh', 'kuh'): record by a person or audition each take; words are spoken naturally; 'slow' words stretch each sound with no gap (sssuuunnn); 'segmented' words say each sound with a short gap (s - u - n).
